description.value: The study explored metabolic connectivity in FDG-PET data for differential diagnosis of mild Alzheimer's disease and frontotemporal lobar degeneration.

spans.text: Thus, the aim of the present work was to explore the value of metabolic connectivity in the differential diagnosis of mild AD and FTLD.
